mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above 4% in the month prior to the prediction is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discounting of future cash flows.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the tightening phase (p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS does not cross the 4% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly UNRATE falls below 5%, labor market slack increases, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or flat despite UNRATE remaining below 5% for at least 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising HOUST (industrial production) exceeding 2% suggests accelerating demand, which precedes a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: HOUST grows >2% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: No significant positive 20-day forward return within 30 days after the two-month surge in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO below 100 (2017=100 index) indicates supply-side contraction, which is associated with a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative or the decline in INDPRO persists for less than 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL above their 12-month averages produce a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as higher rates and inflation erode equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or both proxies fail to cross their respective thresholds simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in PAYEMS (labor market activity) above 150,000 in a month is a leading indicator of a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as hiring momentum supports earnings growth.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.10) or PAYEMS does not exceed 150,000 for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month moving average of GDPC1 (real GDP) exceeding 20000 (Chained 2017) in the prior quarter signals robust demand, predicting a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day forward return is not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during the 3-month GDP expansion window.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS (retail sales) falls for two consecutive months below 600,000, it indicates softening demand and a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 5-day forward return is not negative or RSAFS recovers above 600,000 within 2 weeks.
